description.value: Ha Cafe is a Vietnamese restaurant that has been serving Burnaby since 2006, located directly across from Metrotown on Kingsway. It specializes in pho and freshly cooked Vietnamese cuisine, built on a family kitchen tradition of rich broths and herbs. The restaurant offers both a full dine-in experience and a takeout menu including banh mi, rice, vermicelli, and vegetarian dishes.
